Grand Thali Events & Catering — Wedding & Event Catering, Lucknow

Grand Thali Events & Catering is a Lucknow-based caterer known for authentic
Awadhi cuisine — dum biryani, galouti kebabs, and traditional Lucknowi dum
preparations — served at weddings across Uttar Pradesh.

Their Awadhi non-vegetarian wedding package is ₹1,450 per plate; the vegetarian
Awadhi thali starts at ₹1,100 per plate. They specialize in slow-cooked dum
dishes prepared on-site.
